Fixtures for all 18 RTK pipe filters (groups and expected outcomes: MATRIX). Each case folder has stdout, stderr, exit, and cmd, and optionally markers
(text that must stay visible). The first six filters (group A) are described below. Each case folder has stdout, stderr, exit, and cmd.
Replayed by tests/fixtures/replay-case.sh (FIXTURE_CASE=<filter>/<case>) through the fixture commands in tests/fixtures/bin.

Recorded from real runs on 2026-10-07 (paths scrubbed to /home/user/proj):
  go-test, go-build   go version go1.27.0 linux/amd64, a small module with table tests, t.Log warning lines, and a benchmark
  pytest              pytest 9.1.1, Python 3.12.3, parametrized tests, DeprecationWarning and UserWarning, one failing assert
  tsc                 TypeScript 7.0.2 (tsc), 9 small files, strict mode
  vitest              vitest 5.0.3 on Node 24.15.0, CI=1 NO_COLOR=1, default and verbose reporters

HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded: cargo-test. Cargo is not installed here. The text follows the cargo test output format
(test harness text on stdout, cargo status and compiler warnings on stderr). Treat it as less reliable than the others.

Informational runs (go-test/bench, go-test/pass-json, pytest/collect-only, tsc/showconfig) are real too. They are kept to show
what the filters do with output that is not a plain test run. The cpu line of the Go benchmark is replaced.

Real stdout and stderr are kept apart as the tools wrote them. Notes:
  go build writes only to stderr, so its stdout is always empty.
  vitest writes console warnings and errors to stderr.
  tsc prints nothing on a quiet success and prints errors on stdout.

Groups B to D (2026-10-07):
  RECORDED with real tools: git-status, git-log, git-diff, grep, find. tests/fixtures/record-live-fixtures.sh builds a small project
    (fixed dates, TZ=UTC) and records them. git 2.55.0, ugrep 7.8.4 as grep, bfs 4.1.1 as find.
  HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded (the tool is not installed here): mypy, ruff-check, ruff-format, prettier, rg, fd, log. The text follows the
    documented output format of each tool. rg/many and fd/many reuse the grep and find recordings. Real RTK results on them show how RTK
    treats that text, not how the tool behaves. A prettier "[warn]" line goes to stderr, as in prettier 3.
  Commands that are not installed, and grep, find, and git, replay through tests/fixtures/shim-command.sh (see link-shims.sh). The shim
    replays only the exact recorded command line and runs the real command for anything else.
